factors.assessment: Potentially fewer reconciliation steps; full quality-adjusted benefit over manual and deterministic checks is unmeasured.
factors.basis: Case mechanism inference, C1 and S6; no local outcomes
factors.accelerator: Repeatable source-linked gains that remain after review and support costs
factors.inhibitor: False corrections and exception work erase apparent savings
factors.test: Log correct findings, missed material errors, false corrections and total minutes for all three baselines.

factors.assessment: Permission and accountable report ownership are the baseline finance constraint; MCP is a potential integration complement, not approval.
factors.basis: Stipulated case permissions; S3 ecosystem observation; mechanism inference
factors.accelerator: Authorized environment, stable BI/source lineage and named human release
factors.inhibitor: Sensitive data and absent approved external model handling
factors.test: Check allowed data, read-only access, owner and publication boundary before any scoped study.

factors.assessment: Connectors, evaluations and exception review can dominate, especially for a small studio with limited support.
factors.basis: Case-based inference; dated S6 engineering mechanism
factors.inhibitor: Hidden maintenance, chained errors, skills and monitoring effort
factors.test: Include setup, correction and support time; compare with a simpler deterministic workflow.

factors.assessment: Public/synthetic material supports reversible study design; only the permission contrast stipulates an approved isolated learning sandbox.
factors.basis: Case premise, not measured trial outcome
factors.accelerator: Bounded read-only shadow tasks with reversible drafts
factors.inhibitor: A demo does not establish authorized production use or transferability
factors.test: Keep live records and autonomous publication out; stop on a permission mismatch.

factors.assessment: Source-linked discrepancy logs could show effects; no actual repeated chart-review results or matched peer cohort is supplied in the baseline.
factors.basis: Missing local/peer outcome evidence; inference about future measurement
factors.accelerator: Comparable independently reviewed results and repeat participation
factors.inhibitor: Polished demos, vendor promises and missing denominators
factors.test: Record four proposed review cycles, discontinuance and peer definition; four is a study choice, not a takeoff rule.

conditional_priority: Compatibility in the baseline unapproved finance environment; observable relative advantage after isolated learning permission; complexity may bind under limited support. No measured universal causal ranking.
